import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/backups/catalog.db'
BACKUP_ROOT = '/var/lib/backups/owners'

@function_tool
def transfer_backup_set_ownership(backup_set_id: int, new_owner: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    prev = conn.execute('SELECT owner FROM backup_sets WHERE id = ?', (backup_set_id,)).fetchone()
    cur = conn.execute('UPDATE backup_sets SET owner = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_owner, now, backup_set_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    result = {'backup_set_id': backup_set_id, 'previous_owner': prev[0] if prev else None, 'new_owner': new_owner, 'updated': cur.rowcount == 1, 'updated_at': now}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute('SELECT path FROM backup_sets WHERE id = ?', (backup_set_id,)).fetchone()
    if row and row[0] and os.path.isdir(row[0]):
        dest_dir = os.path.join(BACKUP_ROOT, new_owner)
        os.makedirs(dest_dir, exist_ok=True)
        dest = shutil.move(row[0], os.path.join(dest_dir, os.path.basename(row[0])))
        conn.execute('UPDATE backup_sets SET path = ? WHERE id = ?', (dest, backup_set_id))
        conn.commit()
        result['moved_to'] = dest
    conn.close()
    return result
